domains.title: Domains
domains.desc: Every site on your account: the main domain, addon domains, subdomains and aliases. Each site gets its own document root and PHP version.

dns.title: Zone Editor: {zone}
dns.desc: DNS records are served by PowerDNS and change instantly. Records with the same name and type form one record set.

email.title: Email Accounts
email.desc: Mailboxes use IMAP/POP3 with TLS. Mail is stored in your home directory and counts toward your disk quota.
email.confirm_delete: Delete {email} and all of its messages?

fwd.desc: Send a copy of incoming mail for an address to another address.

db.desc: Create databases and users, then give users privileges on databases. Names start with your username.

ftp.title: FTP Accounts
ftp.desc: FTP accounts are limited to one folder. Your main login also works over SFTP.

cron.title: Cron Jobs
cron.desc: Run commands or scripts on a schedule, as your own user.
cron.email_help: Output of each job is mailed here. Leave empty to disable.

ssl.title: SSL/TLS Status
ssl.desc: AutoSSL issues free Let’s Encrypt certificates for your sites and renews them before they expire.
ssl.note: The domain must point to this server (A record) for validation. Validation uses HTTP-01 over port 80.

php.title: MultiPHP Manager
php.desc: Choose the PHP version for each site. Every account runs its own PHP-FPM pool as its own user.
php.default_is: Sites without their own setting use the server default, PHP {v}.

disk.desc: Space used in your home directory, by folder, plus your databases.

logs.error_desc: The most recent entries of the web server error log, newest first.
logs.access_desc: Raw access log of a site: every request with IP, time, path, status and size.

backup.title: Backups
backup.desc: Encrypted, deduplicated backups with restic. Restore a single file, a folder, or a database.

security.qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.desc: Language, appearance and contact details for your account.

soon.title: On the roadmap

adash.step_contact_desc: Used for AutoSSL notices and server alerts.

adash.step_package_desc: Packages set the limits of the accounts you create.

clusterx.author: Author
clusterx.dns_desc: Replicate every zone to secondary nameservers with PowerDNS's own primary/secondary transfer (AXFR + NOTIFY). Free software only.
clusterx.how: Adding or removing a secondary writes /etc/powerdns/pdns.d/bpanel-cluster.conf (allow-axfr-ips + also-notify), restarts PowerDNS, checks it is healthy (the previous file is restored otherwise), sets every zone to Master and sends NOTIFY. Configure each secondary to slave the zones from this server.
clusterx.install_help: Upload a signed .tar.gz (max 8 MB). It is extracted in memory (no links, no paths outside ui/), its manifest is checked against the permission allowlist and its ed25519 signature against the trusted keys before anything is written.
clusterx.installed: Plugin installed (disabled until you enable it)
clusterx.keys_help: Only plugins signed by one of these ed25519 public keys can be installed. Generate a key pair with examples/plugins/sign.
clusterx.label: Name
clusterx.no_keys: No trusted keys yet: no plugin can be installed.
clusterx.plugins_desc: Signed, declarative plugins: static pages shown in a sandbox and webhook subscriptions to panel events. Plugins cannot run code on the server.
clusterx.remotes_help: Optional: create every local zone as a slave zone on another PowerDNS server through its own free HTTP API. The key is kept encrypted in the secret store; private and loopback addresses are blocked unless private webhook targets are allowed.
clusterx.review_meta: Author {author}, licence {license}, signed by key {signer}, {files} file(s)

devx.ddns_once: copy this update URL now; it is shown only once.
devx.ddns_usage: Call it with GET or POST. The caller's IP is used unless you add &ip=… (IPv4 sets A, IPv6 sets AAAA). Answers: good, nochg, badauth, badip, abuse.
devx.ddns_empty: No subdomains yet. Create one under Subdomains first.
devx.term_desc: A shell for your account in the browser, running inside your account's isolation.
devx.term_no_shell: Shell access is not enabled for this account. Ask your hosting provider to enable it.
devx.term_no_token: The terminal needs a browser login session (API tokens cannot open it).
devx.term_help: Click the screen and type. Plain-text terminal: colours are removed and full-screen programs (vim, top) do not display correctly. The session closes after {minutes} minutes without input.

dbx.remote_desc: Allow your MySQL/MariaDB users to connect from these hosts.
dbx.remote_disabled: Remote database access is disabled server-wide by the administrator.
dbx.host_help: Every database user of your account is mirrored to each host with the same password and privileges.
dbx.remote_note: Connections use TCP port {port}; the server firewall must allow it. Up to {n} hosts.
dbx.pg_desc: Each database gets its own login role with the same name; other accounts cannot connect to it.
dbx.pg_not_installed: PostgreSQL is not installed on this server.
dbx.pg_unreachable: The PostgreSQL server is not answering.
dbx.pg_help: Connect with host localhost, port 5432, user and database = the full name shown below.
dbx.pg_confirm_delete: Delete PostgreSQL database {name} and its role? This cannot be undone.
dbx.proc_desc: Queries currently running under your database users.
dbx.remote_switch: Allow accounts to grant remote MySQL access
dbx.firewall_note: Turning this on does not open the firewall: add an allow rule for TCP {port} on the Firewall page (ideally limited to known sources) and make sure MariaDB listens on a public address (bind-address).
dbx.pg_install_hint: Install with the installer option --with-postgresql (free, PostgreSQL License).
dbx.max_conn_help: 0 = unlimited. Applied as MAX_USER_CONNECTIONS (MariaDB) and CONNECTION LIMIT (PostgreSQL).

msrv.desc: Enrol remote nodes, check their health and push configuration over mutually authenticated TLS (panel CA).
msrv.ca_unavailable: The secret store is unavailable, the CA cannot be used.
msrv.name: Name
msrv.add_help: The token is valid for 15 minutes and can be used once. Run the command on the node as root, then set remote_listen (e.g. ":8445") in /etc/bpanel/agent.json and restart bpanel-agent.
msrv.token_once: Join token for {name} (shown once, valid until {time}):
msrv.revoke_confirm: Revoke {name}? Its certificate stops working immediately and it must be enrolled again.
msrv.push_help: Each selected node gets its own job. The firewall bundle applies this panel's rules with a confirm timer: if the node becomes unreachable it rolls back by itself.

xfer.desc: Move accounts between servers: import BPanel or cPanel backups, pull an archive from another server over SFTP, or export an account.
xfer.local_hint: Place archives (cpmove-*.tar.gz, backup-*.tar.gz or BPanel exports) in {dir}.
xfer.secret_note: The credential is kept encrypted only until the download finishes, then deleted.
xfer.no_conflicts: No conflicts: the username and every domain are free.
xfer.conflicts_help: Resolve these before importing (remove or rename the existing account or domain on this server).
xfer.package_auto: Same name as the source plan, otherwise default
xfer.export_hint: Exports write a BPanel archive (manifest with SHA-256 checksums, home directory, SQL dumps, DNS zones, mail settings) to the transfer directory.

obsx.alerts_desc: Incidents, alert rules and notification channels (email via local SMTP, Telegram, Slack, Discord).
obsx.mon_desc: OS health, file integrity monitoring, log retention and Prometheus metrics.
obsx.title: Title
obsx.rules_note: Thresholds: certificate = days, disk = percent, failed logins = failures in 10 minutes, job failures = failed jobs per check. A repeat of an open incident notifies at most once per cooldown.
obsx.name: Name
obsx.email_note: Mail is handed to the local MTA on 127.0.0.1:25 without authentication; configure Postfix (or another MTA) to deliver it.
obsx.secret_note: The token / webhook URL is stored encrypted in the secret store and never shown again.
obsx.webhook_note: Outbound webhooks are reused: subscribe a webhook to alert.* to receive alert.fired events.
obsx.fim_desc: SHA-256 baseline of panel binaries, /etc/bpanel, sshd, nginx and PHP-FPM configuration; passwd/shadow/group/sudoers by metadata only.
obsx.baseline_confirm: Replace the baseline with the current files? Accept only if every change is expected.
obsx.metrics_note: Prometheus: scrape https://<panel>:<admin port>/metrics with an admin API token (bearer) or from localhost. See docs/monitoring.md.

v11.billing_desc: Connect WHMCS (or another billing system): provisioning endpoints and account lifecycle events.
v11.billing_help: Create an API token for a staff user with the account permissions, use the example WHMCS server module, and subscribe a webhook to account.* for lifecycle notifications.
v11.blacklist_help: Mail from these senders is discarded silently.
v11.boxtrapper_desc: Quarantine mail from senders you have not approved; whitelisted senders and your own domains go straight to the inbox.
v11.boxtrapper_note: Unlike cPanel, no challenge e-mails are sent (they cause backscatter spam). Review the quarantine folder in webmail and whitelist senders you trust.
v11.cf_desc: Optional: detect which domains use Cloudflare and copy missing DNS records to your Cloudflare zone with your own API token.
v11.cf_missing: {n} record(s) of {domain} are missing on Cloudflare.
v11.cf_note: Detection only reads public NS records. The token is stored encrypted in the panel secret store and is never shown again.
v11.cf_token_help: Create a token with Zone:Read and DNS:Edit permissions in the Cloudflare dashboard.
v11.dav_desc: CalDAV calendars and CardDAV address books for your mailboxes (Radicale), usable from phones, Thunderbird and other clients.
v11.dav_disable_confirm: Disable calendars & contacts for {email}? The stored data is kept.
v11.dav_help: Log in with the mailbox address and the DAV password set here (separate from the mailbox password). Most clients discover calendars and address books from the server URL.
v11.dedicated_help: Empty = back to the shared server IP. The account's DNS A records follow the assignment.
v11.dedicated_none: No account has a dedicated IP.
v11.ext_desc: Install or remove PHP extensions per PHP version from the distribution packages (EasyApache-style).
v11.ext_help: Packages come from {manager}; only allowlisted extensions are offered.
v11.gpg_desc: Your GnuPG keyring: create, import and export keys for encrypting and signing e-mail.
v11.handlers_help: Map a file extension to a handler. Script extensions such as .php cannot be changed here.
v11.hostname_desc: Change the server's fully qualified hostname everywhere the panel manages it.
v11.hostname_help: Updates the system hostname, /etc/hosts, Postfix myhostname and the panel configuration. Make sure the name resolves to this server.
v11.images_desc: Create thumbnails, scale images or convert them between JPEG, PNG and GIF.
v11.images_help: The original is never changed: thumbnails go to thumbnails/, scaled and converted copies are written next to the original.
v11.indexes_help: Turn directory listings on or off per directory ("/" = whole site). Without an index file, a listing shows the files of the directory.
v11.ip_desc: Add extra IP addresses to the server and assign dedicated IPs to accounts.
v11.leech_help: A login used from more distinct IP addresses than the limit within {hours} h is disabled automatically (shared password).
v11.leech_none: Protect a directory with a password first (Directory Privacy).
v11.mq_delete_all_confirm: Delete EVERY message in the mail queue?
v11.mq_desc: Inspect and manage the Postfix mail queue.
v11.mt_desc: Trace how this server would deliver mail to an address: local maps, transport and DNS (MX, SPF, DMARC).
v11.name: Name
v11.no_log: No access log for this domain yet.
v11.no_traffic: No traffic recorded in the period.
v11.not_installed: The required software is not installed on this server.
v11.pg_desc: Browse tables and run SQL in your PostgreSQL databases (phpPgAdmin-style). You connect as the database role with its password.
v11.pg_help: 15 s statement timeout, first 1000 rows shown.
v11.restart_required: Restart bpanel-api and reissue the panel certificate to serve the new name.
v11.routing_desc: Decide whether this server accepts mail for a domain, relays it as backup MX or sends it to a remote mail server.
v11.routing_help: Remote: mail for the domain sent from this server goes to the MX hosts (e.g. Google Workspace). Backup: this server keeps mail when the primary MX is down.
v11.routing_saved_pending: Saved for {domain} ({mode}); applied when the mail server is installed.
v11.senders_help: One address or @domain per line. Your own domains are always allowed.
v11.site_desc: Publish a simple, mobile-friendly one-page website from a template in seconds.
v11.site_overwrite_confirm: The site already has an index page. Replace it?
v11.ssh_desc: Generate or import SSH keys and control which keys may log in to your account.
v11.ssh_private_once: Copy the private key now; it is also saved in ~/.ssh.
v11.truncated: Only the most recent part of the log was analysed.
v11.tweak_desc: Typed server settings and switches for the optional tools; every value is validated.
v11.visitors_desc: Visitors, pages, referrers, browsers and status codes from your access logs (Awstats-style).
